# NNCO

> NNCO is an AI consulting and development company. It designs, integrates and
> operates AI systems for large institutions, from an initial AI audit to a
> system running in production. Based in Prague, working across the European
> Union.

NNCO covers the whole arc of an AI implementation: finding where AI is worth
building, building it, deploying it inside the organisation's data and
regulatory constraints, and operating it after launch. Every engagement starts
with an AI audit. NNCO does not publish client names or case studies.

NNCO does not build clinical decision-making software. In healthcare it works
on administrative and operational workflows only.

## Programme
- [AI-First Enterprise](https://nnco.ai/ai-first-enterprise): the cross-industry programme, from audit to systems running in production. Applies to any large organisation.
- [AI audit](https://nnco.ai/ai-first-enterprise/ai-audit): a two to four week review that maps which workflows AI can take over, ranks them, and records the constraints on each.
- [Private AI](https://nnco.ai/ai-first-enterprise/private-ai): on-premise and private deployment of models, retrieval, access control and monitoring.
- [Operation](https://nnco.ai/ai-first-enterprise/operation): monitoring, quality, model replacement and change management after launch.

## Industries
- [Banking](https://nnco.ai/banking): onboarding and KYC, periodic review, transaction monitoring triage, credit files, regulatory reporting.
- [Insurance](https://nnco.ai/insurance): claims intake and review, underwriting support, fraud investigation support, correspondence.
- [Healthcare](https://nnco.ai/healthcare): administrative and operational workflows. Clinical decisions stay with clinicians.
- [Capital markets and asset management](https://nnco.ai/capital-markets): fund and investor reporting, due diligence document review, compliance monitoring.
